description: The constructed history code \(c_n\) decodes to the list of exactly the first \(n\) constructed values.
signature:
Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.history_identity (h : ℕ → ℕ → ℕ) (n : ℕ) :
  Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.decode
      (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.historyCode h n) =
    List.map (Lemmatheca.ComputabilityTheory.FiniteSequenceCoding.historyValue h) (List.range n)
